scatter_tensor_to_mlu: scatter a torch tensor to MLU device by calling scatter with the tensor and device list
scatter_list_of_tensors: scatter a list of torch tensors to MLU devices using the scatter function recursively
Scatter_forward_single_tensor: call Scatter.forward with target MLU devices and a single tensor to get a tuple output
Scatter_forward_list_of_tensors: call Scatter.forward with target MLU devices and a list of tensors to get scattered outputs
